text:
Situation: Epinephrine products at Corvale East and Corvale General carry labels from plants with FDA Official Action Indicated (OAI) classifications and Warning Letters. Corvale East holds 15 days on hand for key syringes; Corvale Lakeside holds 7.4 days. FDA first posted the epinephrine shortage on 2012-02-22 citing manufacturing delay, and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 176 months.

Why (FDA record): The Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG plant (FEI 3002806556) on the Amneal label received an OAI classification from inspection 808119 ending 2012-11-12 and a Warning Letter on 2013-05-06. The Hospira, Inc. plant (FEI 1925262) on the Amneal label received OAI classifications from inspections 976095 ending 2016-06-08 and 1064827 ending 2018-08-15, and a Warning Letter on 2017-02-14. The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 3001833549) on the Fresenius Kabi label received OAI classifications from inspections 732653 ending 2011-07-08 and 815426 ending 2013-01-11, and a Warning Letter on 2012-02-22. The Fresenius Kabi USA LLC plant (FEI 1450022) received OAI classifications from inspections 1123748 ending 2020-05-18 and 1174894 ending 2022-06-30.

Our position: Internal supply is tight at Lakeside. East and General can support limited transfers without dropping below two weeks. External vendors Benco Dental, NDC, Inc., and Viatris Specialty LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today; their listed plants show recent VAI inspections.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 25 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 5 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Place purchase orders with Benco Dental, NDC, Inc., and Viatris Specialty LLC — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
